# hvir

hvir is an Electron desktop workbench for working with terminal-based coding agents. It combines GPU-accelerated terminals (ghostty-web + node-pty), a code/document viewer, Git workflow tools, document review, a web pane, and local or SSH-remote projects in one window.

## Requirements

- Node.js >= 24
- npm
- A toolchain able to compile native modules (`node-pty`, `@hvir/rename-noreplace`) via `node-gyp`
- macOS (arm64 `.pkg`) or Linux (x64/arm64 `.deb`) for packaging

## Getting started

```sh
npm install        # also rebuilds native runtime modules (postinstall)
npm run dev        # start the app in development mode
```

Optional: `npm run hooks:install` installs the repository git hooks.

## Common scripts

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Run the app with electron-vite |
| `npm run build` | Typecheck and build |
| `npm run typecheck` | Typecheck main and renderer projects |
| `npm run lint` / `npm run format` | ESLint / Prettier |
| `npm test` | Unit tests (Vitest) |
| `npm run test:mutation` | Mutation tests (Stryker) |
| `npm run verify` | Seams, ADRs, architecture, lint, typecheck, and tests |
| `npm run smoke` | Build and run Electron smoke scenarios |
| `npm run pack:mac:arm64` | Build a macOS arm64 package |
| `npm run pack:linux:x64` / `pack:linux:arm64` | Build a Linux `.deb` |

## Project layout

- `src/main` – Electron main process (projects, PTY, Git, sessions, SSH hosts, windows)
- `src/preload` – preload bridge
- `src/renderer` – UI
- `src/shared` – code shared across processes
- `src/workers` – worker threads
- `packages/rename-noreplace` – native helper for no-replace renames
- `scripts` – build, smoke, release, ADR, and project-management tooling
- `test` – tests
- `build` – icons, entitlements, and installer assets

## Contributing

Run `npm run verify` before pushing. CI runs on GitHub Actions (see `.github/workflows`).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
